## Step 4: Failed Direct Debit  
### Failure Scenarios  
**Common Reasons:**
- Account closed
- Insufficient funds
- Account frozen
- Mandate canceled (customer didn't inform biller)
name: Chunk 13/26

raw_entities.name: Failed Direct Debit Handling
raw_entities.description: Operational procedure for managing direct debit payment failures on customer accounts. Covers scenarios where direct debits cannot be processed due to account status, insufficient funds, or mandate issues. The process identifies failure reasons and determines appropriate remediation actions.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled

raw_entities.name: Failure Reason Identification
raw_entities.description: Diagnostic step to determine the root cause of a direct debit failure. Evaluates whether the failure is due to account closure, insufficient funds, account freeze, or mandate cancellation.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled (customer didn't inform biller)

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Mandate
raw_entities.description: Standing direct debit instruction on a customer account subject to failure scenarios including mandate cancellation when the customer fails to notify the biller of the cancellation.

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account subject to direct debit processing and potential failure states including closure, freeze, or insufficient funds conditions.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Failure Reason Gate
raw_entities.description: Branching decision point that categorizes the direct debit failure into one of four scenarios: account closure, insufficient funds, account freeze, or mandate cancellation. Each path leads to different remediation handling.
context: Common Reasons: Account closed, Insufficient funds, Account frozen, Mandate canceled (customer didn't inform biller)
